description: CPE MA is conducting market research/sources sought to identify industry capabilities for software and hardware solutions to provide a safety assured control and security architecture for uncrewed air, ground and maritime platforms and their integrated lethal and non-lethal payloads operating under remote control and/or autonomous control. The goal is to provide an independent verifiable level of assured control with safety-critical functions of robotic autonomous systems under various levels of supervision. Supervision may range from an operator in-the-loop to on-the-loop, to complete local autonomy, all in a variety of operational domains.
